title: DID Management — Account Invite Revoke — payload
description: An administrator of a DID hosting service withdraws a pending account invite so it can no longer be redeemed. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

inviteId.description: The invite to revoke, as did-management/account/invite/issue or list reported it.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Invite Revoke — response payload
Response.description: The invite after the request. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

changed.description: `true` when this request revoked a pending invite; `false` when it was already revoked.
